slides.headline: 1) DRAFT ALL YOUR GMAIL REPLIES IN YOUR OWN VOICE
slides.body: Find the sparkle icon (✦) at the bottom of any compose window. Type one sentence about what to say, click Generate, and Gmail writes the full reply in your style.

slides.headline: 2) TURN THREE BULLET POINTS INTO A FOUR-PAGE PROPOSAL
slides.body: Find the AI pen icon or 'Help me write' at the top of any blank Doc. Describe what you need and press Generate. Three bullets in, a four-page proposal out in 45 seconds.

slides.headline: 3) ASK YOUR SPREADSHEET A QUESTION IN PLAIN ENGLISH
slides.body: Find the Explore button in the bottom-right corner of any Sheets file. Type your question, 'Which product made the most money last month?', and press Enter. Sheets reads the whole file.

slides.headline: YOU ALREADY HAVE ALL 5
slides.body: Gmail. Docs. Sheets. Meet. Slides. Google built AI into every one. Almost nobody has switched it on

slides.headline: 4) LET GOOGLE MEET WRITE YOUR MEETING NOTES FOR YOU
slides.body: Click the three-dot menu at the bottom of any Google Meet call and select 'Take notes with Gemini'. You walk out of every call with the notes already done.

slides.headline: 5) BUILD A COMPLETE PRESENTATION FROM ONE SENTENCE
slides.body: Look for the Gemini or AI star icon in the Google Slides toolbar. Type one sentence about your topic and press Generate. A full deck out in about 30 seconds.

caption:
Swipe through all 5. 💡 These AI features are already inside the Google apps most businesses pay for every month and never touch.

Gmail's AI drafts full replies in your own voice, Google Docs turns three bullet points into a complete four-page proposal in 45 seconds, Google Sheets answers any question about your data in plain English without a formula, Google Meet writes and saves your meeting notes automatically when the call ends, Google Slides builds a full presentation from one sentence in about 30 seconds.

Google built AI into the tools most businesses already use and pay for. Almost all of it sits switched off by default. Business owners who find these features are doing in 20 minutes what used to take a morning.
